problem_statement: After a kernel change moved the NuttX debug header from include/debug.h to include/nuttx/debug.h (leaving a deprecation shim behind), the apps-side ostest test testing/ostest/signest.c was updated to include <nuttx/debug.h>. On the old kernel the header include/nuttx/debug.h does not exist, so signest.c fails to compile. The test should compile and run (signest_test executed) once the kernel provides include/nuttx/debug.h, with the signal suite enabled so signest_test is actually invoked.
